flow.name: Sign In — Enter phone and request OTP
flow.notes: Page has heading 'Login' and subheading 'Rupeek Sales App'. The phone field has a +91 country prefix displayed separately — fill only the 10-digit number into the input. The Send OTP button is a full-width orange button. After clicking, the form transitions to an OTP input screen.

actions.label: phone number text input (the editable field next to the +91 country code prefix)
Send OTP — the full-width orange submit button at the bottom of the login card

assertions.label: OTP input field with placeholder 0000 or label Enter the 4 digit OTP

flow.name: Sign In — Enter OTP and login
flow.notes: Form switches to OTP step showing the entered phone number. Fill 4-digit OTP received via SMS, click Login.

assertions.label: any dashboard or check-in page content that confirms login redirect has completed (e.g. Check In link, Check Out banner, Today Schedule, or Check-In heading)
